correctness.summary: Established ordinary mutual-visibility characterisations identify maximal sets with K4-saturated subgraphs of K_n and C4-saturated subgraphs of K_{m,n}. A direct intercomponent-edge argument proves both saturation classes connected; line-graph connectivity then gives connected mutual visibility. Classical extremal and saturation formulas yield the stated values, and exhaustive definition-level checks found no discrepancy.

limitations: The rook-graph formula inherits the unresolved general Zarankiewicz problem.
Classical forbidden-subgraph, Turan, saturation, Bollobas-Wessel and projective-plane ingredients are prior work.
The recency of connected mutual visibility leaves residual unindexed-parallel-work and revision risk.
Finite verification supports but does not replace the symbolic proof.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2026 paper introducing connected mutual visibility was checked and does not treat line graphs, Cartesian products of complete graphs, or Zarankiewicz reductions. Searches under exact and synonymous formulations found no prior connected formula or all-maximal connectivity statement. The ordinary forbidden-subgraph translations and classical extremal ingredients are explicitly treated as prior work; the previously known lower rook-graph formula is not claimed as new.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: The result exactly determines the new connected parameter on triangular graphs and reduces it exactly to the classical Zarankiewicz problem on rook graphs, while proving the stronger phenomenon that every maximal ordinary mutual-visibility set is already connected. It also yields the exact lower mutual-visibility value 2n-3 for L(K_n).
